description: O0/O2 Source cases for the opt-in scoped std/async gather Task. Positive cases run on the native backend; the reject case records the current compiler limitation for async generic throws.

positive.name: success-order
positive.checks: values in input order despite reverse completion order

positive.name: empty-group
positive.checks: empty batch returns an empty value vector

positive.name: unit-values
positive.checks: Unit-valued members produce one slot each and all run

positive.name: slow-first-fast-fail
positive.checks: typed failure survives group-initiated sibling cancellation and is caught after sibling defer

positive.name: fast-fail-first
positive.checks: same fail-fast typed error when the failing member is first

positive.name: mixed-success-fail
positive.checks: mixed success/failure; successful member joined and slow sibling cleaned before typed error

positive.name: multiple-failures-delay
positive.checks: completion-order policy selects the first failure

positive.name: multiple-failures-tie
positive.checks: lowest input index wins a completion tie

positive.name: snapshot-mutation-success
positive.checks: gather snapshots handles before the caller clears and replaces its Vec

positive.name: unstarted-group-cancel
positive.checks: unstarted group cancellation uses the snapshot and waits for both started members

positive.name: external-member-cancel
positive.checks: external member cancellation cancels and drains the other members

positive.name: overlapping-groups-success
positive.checks: two live groups and duplicate enrollment preserve values

positive.name: overlapping-groups-cancel
positive.checks: each ScopeLink contributes one completion decrement across overlapping groups

positive.name: coordinator-cancel
positive.checks: run_until(parent) alone sees member cleanup before the parent completes

positive.name: ordinary-await-cancel
positive.stdout:
true
after.parent
coordinator.cleanup
after.run
child.after
child.cleanup
positive.checks: ordinary Task await cancellation remains early and does not cancel the child

positive.name: await-cancelled-proof
positive.checks: awaiting a cancelled task still cancels the waiter; gather drains without that ordinary await

positive.name: timer-gather
positive.checks: raw timer Task members are already scheduled, mixed with a coroutine member, and need no periodic poll

positive.name: fd-pipe-gather
positive.checks: descriptor members register once for an identical duplicate handle and complete from epoll/kqueue

positive.name: duplicate-task-gather
positive.checks: duplicate Task enrollment produces one start, one cleanup and one value per input slot

positive.name: precompleted-gather
positive.checks: a member completed before gather keeps its value while a still-pending member is activated and awaited

positive.name: prefailed-skips-unstarted
positive.checks: a terminal typed error cancels an unstarted sibling instead of starting it

positive.name: prefailed-first-then-cancelled
positive.checks: an already-failed lower-index member wins over a higher-index member cancellation

positive.name: preexisting-cancel-then-failed
positive.checks: an already-cancelled lower-index member does not erase a higher-index real typed error

positive.name: member-cancel-only
positive.checks: member cancellation propagates when no real typed error exists

positive.name: external-cancel-before-error
positive.checks: external parent cancellation drains member cleanup and propagates cancellation before a later typed error

positive.name: running-cancel-then-error
positive.checks: a running member cancellation and a real typed error observed in the same drain scan keep the typed error

positive.name: pre-cancel-skips-unstarted
positive.checks: a first-scan member cancellation cancels pending members instead of starting an unstarted sibling

reject.name: reject-async-generic-throws
reject.checks: an async function may not declare throws E for a type parameter
